items.title: Fable 5 is Back! Here's the Best Way to Use It...
items.summary:
Want to save time, get more leverage, and stop figuring this AI stuff out from scratch? I put the clearest map and support inside the AI Advantage Club: https://joinaiaclub.com/igor

Anthropic finally brought Fable 5 back and in the same week, they also launched the new Sonnet 5 model. In this video, Igor breaks down everything you need to know about these models and explains which one you should be using. Enjoy!

Links:
https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/introducing-claude-fable-5-and-claude-mythos-5
https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/gemini-study-notebooks/
https://openai.com/index/previewing-gpt-5-6-sol/

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:01 Claude Fable 5 & Sonnet 5
12:12 Gemini Study Notebooks
12:43 Gemini Omni Flash
13:14 GPT-5.6

Let's Connect:
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/igorpogany/

Prompts:

You are helping a non-technical business owner turn their company into a simple AI operating system.
Task:
Build a 30-day AI productivity plan.
Include:
- The 5 highest-value workflows to automate or assist with AI
- The exact first workflow to build this week
- What input each workflow needs
- What output it should produce
- The human review step
- The likely time saved each week
- A simple tech stack using tools a normal business owner can handle
- The first prompt I should paste into Claude to start building this
Context:
I run a small coaching and consulting business with 3 people. We sell workshops, 1:1 coaching, and a monthly membership. Most of our time goes into answering repeated client questions, planning launches, writing emails, turning calls into action plans, updating spreadsheets, and following up with leads. We use Gmail, Google Docs, Zoom, Stripe, Calendly, and a basic CRM.

items.title: The NEW Geometry Behind AI Reasoning (Princeton, Berkeley)
items.summary:
Modern Transformers don't simply fail because they forget: they often fail because their internal representations drift away from the geometry that later computations expect. 

In this video, we'll dissect the mechanistic interpretability behind "DiscoLoop", follow the causal experiments that reveal the hidden representation mismatch inside recurrent Transformers, and see why a simple embedding-alignment principle dramatically improves multi-hop reasoning and out-of-distribution generalization. 

If you're interested in latent reasoning, representation geometry, recurrent architectures, and the future of AI cognition, this paper offers one of the most elegant architectural insights of the year.
